meta.name: ginkgo-cloud-lab
meta.description: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Bioworks Cloud Lab (cloud.ginkgo.bio), a web-based interface for autonomous lab execution on Reconfigurable Automation Carts (RACs). Use when the user wants to run protein expression and purification (cell-free, E. coli, or Pichia), HiBiT or A280 or LabChip quantification, IVT mRNA/circRNA synthesis, thermal shift / developability assays, Echo-MS enzyme or analyte methods, SPR target onboarding, fluorescent pixel art, or otherwise interact with Ginkgo Cloud Lab services. Covers protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering workflows.

copy.tagline: 在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上提交和管理实验方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在云端自动化实验室运行生物实验流程。
copy.tagline_en: Submit and manage protocols on Ginkgo Cloud Lab
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run automated lab experiments on a cloud platform.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能根据你的实验需求,从 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 的协议目录中挑选合适的方案(如蛋白表达纯化、定量检测、mRNA 合成等),并说明输入要求、价格、周期和下单流程。
howto.when: 当你想在 Ginkgo Cloud Lab 上运行蛋白表达纯化、定量检测、mRNA 合成等协议,或需要了解协议选择、输入准备、价格与下单时触发。

say.text: 我想在 Cloud Lab 上跑无细胞蛋白表达,该选哪个协议?
say.note: 会推荐目录中对应的 cell-free 表达协议。

say.text: HiBiT 定量实验的价格和周期是多少?
say.note: 会给出 $39/sample 等价格和周期信息。

say.text: 做 IVT mRNA 合成需要准备什么输入文件?
say.note: 会说明下载模板并上传 FASTA/CSV 等。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you pick suitable protocols from the Ginkgo Cloud Lab catalog based on your experimental needs (e.g., protein expression/purification, quantification, mRNA synthesis) and explain input requirements, pricing, turnaround times, and ordering steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to run protocols such as protein expression/purification, quantification, or mRNA synthesis on Ginkgo Cloud Lab, or when you need help with protocol selection, input preparation, pricing, and ordering.

say_en.text: I'd like to run cell-free protein expression on Cloud Lab. Which protocol should I pick?
say_en.note: Recommends the corresponding cell-free expression protocol.

say_en.text: What are the price and turnaround for HiBiT quantification?
What input files are needed for IVT mRNA synthesis?
say_en.note: Explains downloading the template and uploading FASTA/CSV.
